'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Eastern Ukraine campaign]]
***[[Russia]] captures the village of [[Klishchiivka]] in [[Donetsk Oblast]], Ukraine. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/23/russia-ukraine-war-list-of-key-events-day-818 (Al Jazeera)]
***At least two people are killed and four are injured by Ukrainian shelling in [[Lysychansk]], [[Luhansk Oblast]], Ukraine. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/23/russia-ukraine-war-list-of-key-events-day-818 (Al Jazeera)]
**[[List of military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War|Military aid to Ukraine during the Russo-Ukrainian War]]
***[[Sweden]] announces US$7 billion in military aid to [[Ukraine]] from 2024 to 2026. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2024-05-22/sweden-plans-7-billion-in-military-aid-to-ukraine-for-2024-2026 (Bloomberg)]
**Russia returns six [[Child abductions in the Russo-Ukrainian War|Ukrainian children displaced by the war]] back to Ukraine, in a deal brokered by [[Qatar]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/22/russia-returns-six-children-to-ukraine-in-qatar-brokered-deal-state-media (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2024 New Caledonia unrest]]
**[[Australia]] and [[New Zealand]] begin [[emergency evacuation|evacuating]] their citizens from [[New Caledonia]] amid civil unrest. [https://apnews.com/article/new-caledonia-france-macron-australia-new-zealand-f3d9c67561bda538c5cfda37251573f9 (AP)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[San Pedro Garza García stage collapse]]
**Ten people are killed, including a child, and 213 are injured after a temporary stage collapses in high winds at a campaign event for the [[Citizens' Movement (Mexico)|Citizens' Movement]] party in [[San Pedro Garza Garcia]], [[Nuevo León]], [[Mexico]]. Later, the Nuevo León government pledges 400,000 pesos ($23,900) in compensation to families of the deceased. [https://apnews.com/article/mexico-election-maynez-wind-stage-knocked-over-1c4745f31a5b3caf2bce2db47d7cec12 (AP)] [https://elpais.com/mexico/2024-05-23/muertos-y-heridos-tras-colapso-del-escenario-donde-alvarez-maynez-celebraba-un-mitin-en-nuevo-leon.html (''El País'')] [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/mexican-state-pledges-compensation-stage-collapse-victims-2024-05-24/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[International recognition of the State of Palestine]]
**[[Norway–Palestine relations]], [[Ireland–Palestine relations]], [[Palestine–Spain relations]]
***The governments of [[Norway]], [[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]], and [[Spain]] announce that they will recognise the [[State of Palestine]] as a sovereign state beginning on May 28, and also call for a [[two-state solution]]. In response, [[Israel]] recalls its ambassadors to these countries. [https://www.bbc.com/news/live/world-69047220 (BBC News)]
*[[Russia–NATO relations]]
**The [[Ministry of Defence (Russia)|Russian Ministry of Defence]] proposes to unilaterally adjust [[Russia]]'s maritime border in the [[Baltic Sea]], prompting comments of concern made by Baltic members of [[NATO]], including [[Finland]] and [[Lithuania]]. The Ministry of Defense later retracts the proposal. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/russian-ministry-proposes-revising-baltic-sea-border-2024-05-22/ (Reuters)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c6ppl5v1lwzo (BBC News)] 

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2024 Bishkek riots]]
**The [[Kyrgyzstan|Kyrgyz]] [[Ministry of the Interior (Kyrgyzstan)|Ministry of Internal Affairs]] announces that ten people, including four foreigners, have been detained in connection with violent riots that occurred in [[Bishkek]] last week. [https://www.rferl.org/a/kyrgyz-foreign-nationals-detained-mob-attack/32959434.html (RFE/RL)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2024 Chadian presidential election]]
**[[Prime Minister of Chad|Prime Minister]] [[Succès Masra]] of the [[National Transitional Council (Chad)|transitional government]] resigns after [[Mahamat Déby]] is elected [[President of Chad|President]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/22/chad-prime-minister-resigns-after-disputed-vote-winner-confirmed (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2024 United Kingdom general election]]
**[[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Prime Minister]] [[Rishi Sunak]] announces that the [[2024 United Kingdom general election|next general election]] will be held on 4 July. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/05/22/uk/uk-early-elections-sunak-conservatives-intl/index.html (CNN)]
*[[2024 Vietnamese presidential election]]
**[[Ministry of Public Security (Vietnam)|Security Minister]] [[Tô Lâm]] is elected [[President of Vietnam|President]] by the [[National Assembly of Vietnam|National Assembly]], two months after the resignation of [[Võ Văn Thưởng]] amid the ruling [[Communist Party of Vietnam|Communist Party]]'s [[Corruption in Vietnam|anti-corruption campaign]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/vietnam-elects-to-lam-as-new-president/a-69145381 (DW)]
*[[President of the United States]] [[Joe Biden]] announces a [[Student loans in the United States|student loan debt]] cancellation of $7.7 billion for 160,000 people. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/22/biden-cancels-7-7bn-more-in-student-debt-for-160000-borrowers (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Germany|German]] far-right party [[Alternative for Germany]] bans [[Maximilian Krah]], its leading candidate in European elections, from further activities due to his comments defending members of the [[Schutzstaffel]] (SS). [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/22/germanys-afd-bans-top-candidate-from-eu-poll-events-over-nazi-comments (Al Jazeera)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Russia]] launches a [[Soyuz-2]] rocket carrying the [[Kosmos (satellite)|Kosmos 2576 satellite]] from the [[Plesetsk Cosmodrome]] launch site in [[Arkhangelsk Oblast]]. The [[United States Space Command]] accuses it of being an [[anti-satellite weapon]] capable of attacking other satellites, and is in the same orbit as a satellite operated by the [[National Reconnaissance Office]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/5/22/russia-launches-space-weapon-in-path-of-us-satellite-pentagon (Al Jazeera)]
*The [[United Nations Security Council]] votes against a resolution introduced by [[Russia]] and [[China]] banning member states from placing weapons in [[outer space]]. [https://www.space.com/russian-space-weapon-ban-un-security-council (Space.com)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2023–24 UEFA Europa League]]
**In [[association football]], [[Atalanta BC|Atalanta]] win the [[UEFA Europa League]] over [[Bayer 04 Leverkusen|Bayer Leverkusen]] by a score of 3–0 in the [[2024 UEFA Europa League final|final]], ending Bayer Leverkusen's [[European association football club records and statistics#Longest unbeaten run across all competitions|record]] of 51 unbeaten games. It is also Atalanta's first major trophy since 1963. [https://www.theguardian.com/football/live/2024/may/22/atalanta-v-bayer-leverkusen-europa-league-final-live-score-updates (''The Guardian'')]
